scenario.title: Research study: how students get to campus
scenario.intro: A researcher from the urban planning department is interviewing students about how they travel to campus.

questions.text: To begin, could you tell me how you usually get to campus, and about how long the trip takes?
Can you describe a time when your usual way of getting to campus didn't work, and what you did instead?
Some people think universities should reduce the number of parking spaces to encourage students to take the bus or ride bicycles. What is your opinion?
How do you think the way students travel to campus will change over the next ten years, and why?
